subject: Re: Board pre-read — Q3 retention + product risk slides
body:
Subject: Re: Board pre-read — Q3 retention + product risk slides

Hi Chief of Staff,

I've taken ownership of the product risk narrative and will ensure the slides are crisp with three bullets max. I've also reviewed the Amplitude summary and Datadog metrics, and I'm happy to confirm that the p95 API latency is within SLO except for the Sep 7 incident window.

Regarding the risk themes, I'll focus on platform migration and Acme ask. I'll also keep the Insights v2 slip in mind, but I'll prioritize the two main risks.

I'll review Maya's outline for the talking points and ensure the slides lock is in place. I'll also confirm with Nina which risk themes to focus on during our 20-min scrub.

Please let me know if there's anything else I can do to prepare for the Board meeting on 9/18.

Best,
Alex
